title: avena elatior var. precatoria
intro: Avena elatior var. precatoria, commonly known as Oat straw, is a type of oat plant used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. Oat straw is known for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of oat straw include its ability to act as a nervine, sedative, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a popular ingredient in herbal supplements and teas. The bioactive constituents of oat straw include avenanthramides, a type of polyphenolic compound, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
